name: Vesperal-Glen
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near orbital debris ring.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Nothing about radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on water, nitrogen, carbon and helium-3 are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
